notes: Only the wall sections between your commander and the camera fade now, instead of the whole wall.
The healing cross is a smaller bobbing 3D cross that floats over the guard and vanishes at the top of each bounce, and the medic kneels beside the guard while healing.
Every level is open from the start while the game is still changing, so you can jump straight to any level.
Gate and defence icons no longer pulse in and out while they take hits. They shake once when danger starts and again on a hit, then glow steady red.
